newsitem.title: USA: ITI Tech, Westar Security in supply pact.
newsitem.headline: ITI Tech, Westar Security in supply pact.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said Tuesday its Interactive Technologies Inc subsidiary has entered into a supply agreement with Westar Security Services, a subsidiary of Western Resources Inc.

Under the agreement, ITI has agreed to develop a custom wireless security system to Westar's specifications. Upon completion of the system, Westar has agreed to purchase from ITI all of its requirements for wireless security equipment for two years.

ITI also said it has entered into a strategic alliance with Westar in conjunction with ITI's HomeLink security program. Under the arrangement with ITI, Westar can offer people who own HomeLink equipped vehicles the ability to control the home's security system and lights from inside their vehicles.
ITI designs and makes wireless electronic security systems in the United States. ITI had revenues of $93.3 million in 1996.
